title: setConfig
description:
Apply a new configuration.

The plugin validates first and answers `validation.bad_params` without applying anything if the config is wrong — a half-applied config is worse than a rejected one.

Whether this can be done live depends on the `config.reload` capability. Without it the plugin answers `restartRequired: true` and the core schedules a restart.

restartRequired.description: The config was accepted and stored but will not take effect until the plugin restarts.
